🔥 Google-Maps-Scrapper | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automated extraction of business information from Google Maps for analysis and integration into other applications.
✨ Key Features: • Data Scraping from Google Maps listings • Extraction of business name, address, website, contact details • Scraping of review counts and average ratings • Detection of business services (in-store shopping, pickup, delivery) • Extraction of operating hours and introductory information
📖 Summary: This Python repository uses Playwright to scrape business information from Google Maps, extracting details like name, address, website, reviews, and operating hours. It cleans the data and exports it to a CSV file for further analysis.
